visual.description: Single-row full-width bar with centered text link and a close icon on the far right.
Navigation split into three zones: left (menu + search), center (logo), right (language, account, wishlist, cart).
Full-viewport-width background video/image with centered text overlay containing an eyebrow label, large heading, body copy, and a pill-shaped CTA button; pause control at bottom-left.
Six equally-spaced columns on a white background, each containing a product image above a centered text label.
Full-width dark/warm-toned cinematic image with large centered logo text animating over it, transitioning to a collaboration feature.
Full-width dark image with a handwritten headline and a centered underlined link overlaid at the bottom-center.
Two equal columns side by side: left column is a beige/cream tone with eyebrow, heading, and a text link; right column is a warm terracotta-toned image.
Two equal columns: left is a dark tonal image, right has a darker background with eyebrow, multi-line heading, body copy, and a text link.
Two equal columns: left has a dark warm background with eyebrow, large heading, body text, and a text link; right is a neutral-toned product image.
Centered modal overlay split equally into left (branded image on terracotta background) and right (eyebrow, headline, body, CTA button, and dismiss link on white background).
Dark full-width footer band with a locale/country selector pill on the left and a scroll-to-top arrow on the right.
Two equal columns of stacked text links on a dark background (Store locator, Material Library, Shipping & Returns, FAQ on left; Newsletter, Press Area, Jobs on right).
Full-width dark bar with social icon row on the left and legal/policy links plus copyright on the right, all on a single line.
